name: Tokyo
description: Japan's busy capital, mixes the ultramodern and the traditional, from neon-lit skyscrapers to historic temples.

name: Paris
description: France's capital, is a major European city and a global center for art, fashion, gastronomy and culture.

name: Bali
description: An Indonesian island known for its forested volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches and coral reefs.

name: New York City
description: A global hub of culture, entertainment, and business, famous for its skyline and fast-paced lifestyle.

name: Rome
description: Italy's capital, a sprawling, cosmopolitan city with nearly 3,000 years of globally influential art, architecture and culture on display.

name: London
description: The capital of England and the United Kingdom, is a 21st-century city with history stretching back to Roman times.

name: Kyoto
description: Once the capital of Japan, famous for its numerous classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

name: Dubai
description: A city and emirate in the United Arab Emirates known for luxury shopping, ultramodern architecture and a lively nightlife scene.
